text.name: Chinese Anti-Satellite Test
text.rules: Record "debris field". Draw from SAE's Contingency deck. If the result is 3 or more, SAE spends 2 points; otherwise, SAE spends 1 point, then LIO spends 1 point. Raise Escalation by 1.
text.history: On 11 January 2007 China destroyed one of its own defunct weather satellites with a ground-launched missile, creating more than 3,000 pieces of trackable debris; it acknowledged the test on 23 January.
